title: Kanban board with columns and tasks
tasks: kanban board with columns and tasks

requirements.text: Users create, list, view, rename and delete boards; a new board starts with To Do, In Progress and Done columns
Columns and tasks can be added, edited, deleted and reordered; tasks carry a priority and an optional assignee
Moving or reordering tasks keeps a stable order, and competing moves are serialized so only one wins
Writes run in transactions and fail closed without them; deleting a board removes its columns and tasks
With server authorization configured, anonymous requests get 401 and denied requests 403 on every operation, and client-supplied ownership is ignored
Board data is stored in the app's database through a migration and survives a restart
The board list, new-board and board pages render server-side without console errors, with assignees resolved from the app's users

implementations.notes: Upstream BTST tests cover these (e2e/tests/smoke.kanban.spec.ts, plugins/kanban/__tests__/authorization.test.ts at v4.5.1), but Genlib has not run the profile end to end in an app, so nothing is credited above plan-available.

notes: Genlib has no Kanban module of its own; the BTST provider profile (genlib provider check btst-kanban) is the adoption path.
